scope: Diagnostic CPU evaluation of the same seeded 512-token shape trajectory at pipeline BF16 tensor boundaries with FP32 GEMM/attention accumulation; no native BF16, CUDA or TT kernel equivalence claim.
finding: The emulated trajectory differs 23.9% from FP32. Stock and optimized TT remain about 39.7% and 38.8% from this diagnostic, respectively. Mismatch persists against a precision-aware reference; investigate per-operation math and real conditions. This is not an additive error decomposition.
pairing_note: Prior artifacts lack explicit condition digests. All runs use the same checkpoint, seed and construction recipe; noise/coordinates match. New diagnostic stores condition/config identity. These comparisons are numerical diagnostics, not accepted reconstruction quality.
decision: Retain strict FP32 failures and keep real-RoPE opt-in. Do not reinterpret this diagnostic as a relaxed acceptance gate.
